entities.summary: Stian Carstensen (b. 1971-01-05, Eidsvoll Municipality) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Eidsvoll Municipality and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
